title: Tax Strategy for Traders
subtitle: US federal tax rules for active traders, from holding periods and wash sales to section 1256, section 475 and Form 8949, each figure cited to its IRS source and tax year.
what_you_learn: How short- and long-term gains are taxed: the 2025 and 2026 brackets, the 0/15/20% rates, the 3.8% NIIT and the day-after holding-period count
How FIFO, specific identification and average basis change a bill, and how losses net on Schedule D under the $3,000 limit and carryforward rules
The section 1091 wash-sale rule across accounts, spouses and IRAs, and a dated tax-loss harvesting walk-through including the replacement-security question
Section 1256 futures and index options (60/40, year-end mark, Form 6781) and equity options: premiums, exercise, assignment and qualified covered calls
Trader tax status, the section 475(f) election and its deadline, trader deductions, estimated-tax safe harbours, retirement accounts, crypto and forex
How to reconcile a 1099-B to Form 8949 and Schedule D, what records to keep and for how long, and a graded twelve-trade capstone return
